name: graphysdk
description: Agent skills for integrating Graphy SDK packages

plugins.name: graphy
plugins.description: Build charts with the Graphy SDK (@graphysdk/react; advanced embedding via @graphysdk/viz-engine + @graphysdk/react-renderer): install or set it up in a React codebase, author grammar-of-graphics specs, style them from the spec stylesheet, add annotations and highlights, and make charts editable — commands, undo/redo, annotations, the optional editor panel. Activates on requests to author or style Graphy charts, to install, configure or fix a Graphy install, or to embed or drive Graphy's chart editing.
